sections.text:
Ability Power 210. Damages all enemies 2 times with magic light damage at success of 100 points.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Removes debuffs from all allies.
-Increases critical hit chance of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Casts blind on all enemies for 60 seconds at success of 90 points.
-Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) for yourself by 20% for 50 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases Unison Gauge of all allies excluding yourself by 15.
[Unison Effect Boost] Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) for all allies.
